fichas.title: Outdoor public pools: planning and facilities
fichas.summary: Planning guidance for outdoor public pools, including site and parking provisions, entrance and changing facilities, sanitary and staff spaces, covered and open areas, and play areas. The room-and-area relationship diagram indicates internal links only and is not intended for room planning.
